{"settings":"{
  // Backend profile
  // Window appearance
  "window.title": "${activeRepositoryName} - ${profileName} profile",
  "workbench.colorCustomizations": {
    // Background colors
    "titleBar.activeBackground": "#655bf0",
    "titleBar.inactiveBackground": "#655bf0",
    "activityBar.background": "#655bf0",
    "statusBar.background": "#655bf0",
    // Borders
    "titleBar.border": "#655bf0",
    "statusBar.border": "#655bf0",
    // Foreground colors
    "statusBar.foreground": "#ffffff",
    "titleBar.activeForeground": "#ffffff",
    "titleBar.inactiveForeground": "#ffffff",
    "activityBar.foreground": "#ffffff",
    "activityBar.inactiveForeground": "#ffffff"
  },
  "workbench.editor.showTabs": "single",
  "workbench.statusBar.visible": false,
  "files.autoSave": "afterDelay",
  "javascript.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabled": "always",
  "editor.formatOnSave": true,
  "typescript.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabled": "always",
  "explorer.confirmDelete": false,
  "editor.formatOnPaste": true,
  "files.autoSaveDelay": 10000,
  "workbench.activityBar.location": "top",
  "terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.windows": "PowerShell",
  "workbench.layoutControl.enabled": false,
  "workbench.editor.tabSizingFixedMinWidth": 100,
  "terminal.integrated.fontSize": 12,
  "editor.mouseWheelZoom": true,
  "workbench.list.mouseWheelScrollSensitivity": 3,
  "git.confirmSync": false,
  "diffEditor.ignoreTrimWhitespace": false,
  "editor.minimap.enabled": false,
  "window.commandCenter": false,
  "[jsonc]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "vscode.json-language-features"
  },
  "debug.console.fontSize": 12,
  "csharp.debug.console": "integratedTerminal",
  // VS solution extension settings
  "vssolution.lineEndings": "crlf",
  "vssolution.openProjectOnClick": true,
  "vssolution.trackActiveItem": true,
  "workbench.iconTheme": "vscode-icons",
  "vssolution.showMode": "explorer",
  "[csharp]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "ms-dotnettools.csharp"
  },
  "dotnet.formatting.organizeImportsOnFormat": true,
  "debug.terminal.clearBeforeReusing": true,
  "testing.alwaysRevealTestOnStateChange": true,
  "testing.automaticallyOpenPeekView": "failureAnywhere",
  "workbench.sideBar.location": "right",
  "github.copilot.nextEditSuggestions.enabled": true,
}"}
